responsibility: Declares the public interface for diagnostic colorization control. It defines the diagnostic_color_rule_t policy enum for never/always/auto color use and exposes helpers to initialize color support and fetch named start/stop escape sequences, serving as the lightweight API used by the diagnostic and pretty-print layers without exposing the parsing logic of GCC_COLORS.
same_name_distinction: Header for the diagnostic-color pair: it declares the public color policy enum and colorize_start/colorize_stop/colorize_init interface, while diagnostic-color.cc contains the actual color capability table, GCC_COLORS parsing, and terminal/url autodetection logic.
